title: Revit Tag and Parameter Mapping Governed Fields

entries.name: Tag family identity
entries.requirement: Each governed tag family shall have a stable identity and controlled source/library reference.

entries.name: Host category or tagged object class
entries.requirement: Each governed tag mapping shall identify the Revit category or object class to which the tag applies.

entries.name: Displayed governed parameters
entries.requirement: Each data field displayed by the tag shall map to an approved parameter identity from the applicable parameter registry or project-governed extension.

entries.name: Optional displayed parameters
entries.requirement: Optional tag fields shall be explicitly distinguished from required fields and shall not be populated with manual text when a governed parameter is required.

entries.name: Applicable view and scale scope
entries.requirement: The mapping shall identify the view types, purposes, or scale ranges for which the tag family is approved where applicability is constrained.

entries.name: Leader and orientation behavior
entries.requirement: Where leader, orientation, or fixed-paper behavior is governed, the mapping shall reference the approved behavior rather than project-local overrides.

entries.name: Schedule and register alignment
entries.requirement: Tag parameter mappings shall remain semantically aligned with related schedules, registers, and deliverable fields so the same governed data is not represented by conflicting manual text.

entries.name: Manual text substitution boundary
entries.requirement: Where a governed tag/parameter mapping exists, free text shall not be used as a substitute for the governed data field except through an explicitly approved exception.

entries.name: Approved deviation
entries.requirement: Any project-specific deviation from the governed tag/parameter mapping shall be traceable to the applicable approval and rationale.

non_promoted_source_content: No placeholder door, equipment, grid, level, room, or space tag family name from the source is promoted as canonical.
No unresolved family appearance or parameter-list example is treated as an approved tag profile.

provenance.migration_note: Normalizes the durable source rule that tags are controlled, parameter-driven, and aligned with schedules while leaving family-specific TODO values unresolved.
